from sphinx.ext.autodoc.importer import get_class_members
from sphinx.util.inspect import safe_getattr

class A:
    @classmethod
    @property
    def f(cls):
        """Some class property."""
        return 1

members = get_class_members(A, ['A'], safe_getattr)
print('members keys:', list(members.keys()))
val = members['f'].object if hasattr(members['f'], 'object') else members['f'].value
print('type of member value:', type(val))
print('is property:', isinstance(val, property))
print('doc:', val.__doc__)
